The §6Portable Cell§f is a wearable §6ME Storage Cell§f that connects wirelessly to your ME network via a §6Wireless Access Point§f. It combines a chest, energy cell, and storage component into one item.

Crafted from §6ME Chest§f, §61k ME Storage Component§f, and §6ME Energy Cell§f. It holds §b20,000 AE§f internally and draws §b0.5 AE/t§f idle, §b1 AE/t§f when connected.

The wireless range is §b16 blocks§f base, extendable with §6Range Cards§f. You can install §6Capacity§f and §6Acceleration Cards§f just like a regular ME Drive.

§ePS:§f Place a §6Wireless Access Point§f at your mining site, then activate the Portable Cell to connect. One channel consumed by the access point, so plan cabling accordingly.
